description: This file appears to be a header file (.h) defining configuration functions for a Mazda Miata engine with VVT (Variable Valve Timing). It includes function declarations for setting injector timing, TPS (Throttle Position Sensor), and engine configurations specific to a 2003 Mazda Miata.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNbInjectorLag
methods.description: Sets the injector lag parameters for Mazda Miata NA engine.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNbTpsTps
methods.description: Configures TPS parameters for Mazda Miata NA engine.

methods.name: setMazdaMiata2003EngineConfiguration
methods.description: Applies 2003 Mazda Miata engine configuration settings.

methods.name: setMazdaMiata2003EngineConfigurationNaFuelRail
methods.description: Configures the engine with Na Fuel Rail for 2003 Mazda Miata.

methods.name: setMazdaMiata2003EngineConfigurationBoardTest
methods.description: Sets up a board test configuration for the 2003 Mazda Miata engine.
